subject: POC Success Criteria & KPIs
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Asha Shah <asha@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Success Criteria & KPIs 

Hi Asha -

Thanks again for taking the demo and discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned heading into a POC:

Goals (as discussed):
- Validate Redwood can meet Atlas Payments' latency and throughput needs for customer-facing chat and webhook enrichment flows.
- Measure quality (intent recognition + entity extraction) against your sample dataset.
- Establish realistic cost-per-token and per-request unit economics for the production shape.

Initial success criteria (proposal):
- Latency: p90 < 200ms (inference only), p95 < 300ms under target production traffic pattern
- Throughput: sustained 150 RPS with bursts to 300 RPS (batching and concurrent workers considered)
- Cost: < $0.002 / token (inference cost baseline for planning)
- Quality: >= 95% intent accuracy on your core flows and no critical regression on key intents

Evaluation plan & ownership:
- Redwood provides: POC plan, load scripts, monitoring dashboard access, and initial kernel/quantization profile suggestions (Jordan + Marissa)
- Atlas provides: sample dataset (anonymized), expected traffic profile, and a technical owner for test execution (your side)

Timeline (proposed):
- Week of May 24: POC kick-off and environment prep
- Week 1: baseline runs and tuning
- Week 2: sustained load tests + quality evaluation against sample set
- Week 3: remediation tuning and final report
- Week 4: wrap, go/no-go decision and handoff plan

Next steps:
1) I'll attach a short POC plan and a KPI workbook for you to review (attached).
2) Can you confirm the internal owner and a preferred kickoff date?
3) Please share an anonymized sample of 1-2k typical requests (or a subset) and an expected traffic profile (RPS, average tokens/request).

Attaching: redwood-poc-plan.pdf, poc-success-kpis.xlsx

Thanks - looking forward to moving quickly on this.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Asha Shah <asha@atlaspayments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@atlaspayments.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Success Criteria & KPIs - Atlas Payments (recap + next steps)

Jordan -

Appreciate the clear recap. Tom (cc'd) will be our technical owner and will lead the test execution on our side. A few clarifications from our side:

- Latency: our SLO for customer-facing flows is p95 < 150ms end-to-end. We understand inference-only will be higher; we'd like to prioritize keeping model inference under ~120-150ms if possible.
- Throughput: the 150 RPS sustained number is accurate for peak regional traffic; we can provide a distribution by region.
- Quality: for the initial POC, we care most about intent accuracy on the payment-initiation flow and false-positive rate on fraud rules.

We can share an anonymized dataset (~2k records) by Friday. Tom will also send the expected RPS/time-of-day profile.

We don't require an NDA for this POC, but procurement will want a standard MSA/POC addendum if we move to dedicated capacity.

We're fine with kickoff the week of May 24 - would prefer May 25 if Redwood is available.

Thanks,
Asha
Director, Product - Atlas Payments
asha@atlaspayments.com

On Tue, May 18, 2027 at 3:12 PM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Asha -
> 
> Thanks again for taking the demo and discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned heading into a POC: ...

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Asha Shah <asha@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@atlaspayments.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Success Criteria & KPIs - Atlas Payments (updated plan + asks)

Thanks Asha - great to have Tom onboard. I updated the KPI workbook based on your latency request and the note about fraud false-positive sensitivity. Summary of adjustments:

- Inference latency targets: aim for p90 < 150ms, p95 < 220ms for inference-only in our controlled test; will surface end-to-end estimates once we have network topology and client-side timings.
- Quality checks: we'll include intent accuracy and a simple fraud-rule backtest (false positive rate) in the workbook.
- Cost estimates: populated with two variants (full fp16 vs 4-bit quantized) so you can weigh cost vs quality.

Action items for Atlas (please):
- Share anonymized sample (~2k rows) and mapping of fields
- Provide expected RPS and percentiles by region (CSV or a short doc)
- Confirm kickoff: May 25 or May 26 (we can do May 25 if Tom confirms)

What Redwood will deliver:
- A dedicated POC runbook and load scripts
- Access to a dashboard with per-route latency and cost breakdowns
- A short write-up of recommended quantization/profile for production

I've attached an updated poc-success-kpis.xlsx with the adjusted KPI sheet.

If Tom can share the dataset link, we'll start validating data schema and preparing the environment.

Best,
Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Asha Shah <asha@atlaspayments.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Success Criteria & KPIs - Atlas Payments (CS ramp plan)

Hi Asha / Jordan -

Looping in CS plans and what we'll support operationally during the POC:

- Onboarding: coordinate a 60-90 min kickoff session (walkthrough of dashboards, test plan, and roles)
- Instrumentation: we'll provide tracing hooks and a small SDK to capture latency tokens and per-request metadata.
- Monitoring: we'll stand up a temporary dashboard with route-level p50/p90/p95 and cost/token breakdowns.
- Post-POC: deliver a 1-page summary with recommended production profile and any configuration changes.

Please flag any compliance or ingestion constraints early so we can prep redaction/PII controls.

- Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Asha Shah <asha@atlaspayments.com>

Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Success Criteria & KPIs - Atlas Payments (confirm kickoff + next steps)

Jordan / Marissa -

Confirming kickoff for Tuesday, May 25 at 10:00 AM PT. Tom will share the anonymized dataset and RPS profile by EOD Monday. Dev Ops will help with network topology notes so you can estimate end-to-end latency.

Agreed on the adjusted targets (p90 inference < 150ms) and the quality focus on payment-initiation intent + fraud false-positive checks. We're aligned on the 3-4 week POC cadence; procurement will engage if we move to a committed instance.

Next steps:
- Tom to share dataset + traffic profile (by Mon EOD)
- Jordan/Marissa to confirm environment details and send kickoff invite (today)
- Redwood to run a quick smoke test and share dashboard link during kickoff

Thanks - looking forward to it.

Best,
Asha Shah
Director, Product - Atlas Payments
asha@atlaspayments.com
